description: This file defines the API routes related to game functionalities in a tic-tac-toe game using FastAPI. It allows creating a game, joining a game, making a move, retrieving game state, and listing games for the current user.

methods.name: create_game( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: UserDB = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new game with the current user as player 1.

methods.name: join_game( game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: UserDB = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Allows a user to join an existing game as player 2.

methods.name: make_game_move( game_id: int, move: Move, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: UserDB = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Facilitates making a move in the game based on user's input.

methods.name: get_game( game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: UserDB = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified game.

methods.name: list_games( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: UserDB = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Lists all games where the current user is a participant.
